description: This file defines a PHP class 'TextValue' that provides methods for creating and managing conditional formatting rules based on text values within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes functionality for common text operations like 'contains', 'begins with', and 'ends with', as well as converting these into conditional expressions.

classes.name: TextValue
classes.description: A class used for defining conditional formatting rules based on specific text values and patterns within a spreadsheet, supporting operations like 'contains' and 'startsWith'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextValue object with a specified cell range.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the operator type for the conditional formatting rule, throwing an exception if the operator is invalid.

methods.name: operand
methods.description: Sets the operand value for the rule, including its type (literal, cell reference, or formula).

methods.name: wrapValue
methods.description: Encloses a value in double quotes, escaping existing quotes.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Constructs the logical expression based on the operator and operand, formatted for spreadsheet formulas.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Creates and returns a Conditional object representing the current text-based conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an instance of TextValue from an existing Conditional object, attempting to infer the type of operand.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Enables magic method calls to define text operations via method names like 'contains' or 'beginsWith'.
